input_constraint: every retained input has red rectangles at perpendicular distances 0, 1, 2, and 4 from a paired marked line
parameter_selection: one episode-level exact integer selected before input generation
racket_source:
(rule! (lambda (g)
  (let ((blues (find-color g 1))
        (h (rows g)) (w (cols g))
        (objs (objects g 0)))
    (let ((vcols (map snd (filter (lambda (p) (or (zero? (fst p)) (= (fst p) (- h 1)))) blues)))
          (hrows (map fst (filter (lambda (p) (or (zero? (snd p)) (= (snd p) (- w 1)))) blues))))
      (let ((touched-objs (filter (lambda (obj)
              (for/or ((cell (obj-cells obj)))
                (let ((r (fst cell)) (c (snd cell)))
                  (or (member? c vcols)
                      (member? r hrows)))))
            (filter (lambda (obj) (= (obj-color obj) 2)) objs))))
        (let ((g2 (reduce (lambda (acc vc)
                    (reduce (lambda (g3 r2) (set-cell g3 r2 vc 1)) acc (range 0 h)))
                  (reduce (lambda (acc hr)
                    (reduce (lambda (g3 c2) (set-cell g3 hr c2 1)) acc (range 0 w)))
                    g hrows)
                  vcols)))
          (reduce (lambda (acc obj)
            (reduce (lambda (g3 cell) (set-cell g3 (fst cell) (snd cell) 1))
              acc (obj-cells obj)))
            g2 touched-objs)))))))
